verdict.rationale: GOV.UK guidance states some prerequisites before you start. It says to register the company with Companies House, then add Corporation Tax services to a business tax account, and it links an 'HMRC online services: sign in or set up an account' entry point. The Making Tax Digital sign-up page calls out the compatible-software check and the agent alternative before sign-up. Nothing in the evidence spells out the credential type or identity-proofing steps (what ID verification is required, what documents are needed, how long it takes), so the full gate sequence is not shown to be published upfront. missing for 10: explicit statement of credential/login requirements, identity-verification steps and documents needed, an end-to-end ordered list of gates before filing, independent or hands-on corroboration that nothing surfaces mid-flow.
